description: This file implements a JSON and YAML serializer for Kubernetes runtime objects, including decoding, encoding, and stream framing functionalities.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of versioned objects into JSON or YAML formats, with options for strictness, pretty printing, and streaming.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data into a runtime object, inferring GVK and handling different input formats.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Serializes a runtime object into JSON or YAML, writing to an io.Writer.

methods.name: IsStrict
methods.description: Returns whether the serializer is configured for strict decoding.

methods.name: unmarshal
methods.description: Performs strict or non-strict unmarshalling of data into a runtime object.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the serializer based on its options.

methods.name: RecognizesData
methods.description: Detects if the data is JSON or YAML for recognition purposes.
